purpose: Unified notification trigger and delivery inbox with active-backlog context, filtered evidence, triage actions, optional threaded view and period reporting.
primaryGoal: Inspect notification evidence, investigate its source, and manage read/archive/lifecycle status without confusing the recent sample with complete period totals.

dataSources.behavior: safeArray selectors; metadata joins for rule and vehicle names; query status is discarded by the page.
Unfiltered active sample, intentionally independent of workspace date and evidence filters. Latest-50 wording is source UI intent; server default limit was not inspected.

URL severity/vehicle_id/rule_id/source/q/read/view/size plus shared date instants; flat or grouped enabled exclusively; count removes pagination; grouped members lazy-load with parent filters. Reads forward AbortSignal and retain distinct query keys.
Full-period report intent; five metrics, adaptive day/month/year timeline and five breakdowns; historical provenance. Backend filtering/aggregation execution is unverified.

dataSources.inspection: Hook declarations/request paths located by scoped search, not all mutation bodies semantically reviewed.
dataSources.behavior: Per-member and bulk actions, delete confirmation, undo read changes, local read-on-open/read-on-click preferences. Global mark-all uses {all:true}; visible-ID undo is narrower. Do not silently change this existing action scope.

Notification id is used as alert-detail id while alert_id resolves a rule. Backend identifier equivalence was not inspected; preservation requires integration verification rather than an invented remapping.

Optional feature-gated propose-only stream; applying validated proposed rule IDs changes URL filters, not persisted business state. Endpoint registration was not established in inspected router ranges; no missing-route claim.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Pass-through PageContainerProps; full-width min-w-0 container; existing header/actions/copy-link/freshness and page error boundary. Root only supplies summaryQuery for freshness, not a global error gate.

components.name: OperationalBrief / useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: compact, loading, metrics, scope, freshness, provenance, attention; source-native metric values and missing states. Used by InboxSummary and report.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: Existing UI table consumer, stable notifications:inbox identity, controls, selection, expansion, mobileColumns, visibility/reorder/resize and pagination. Shared table implementation not inspected.

components.name: ChartContainer and chart barrel
components.contract: Canonical frame, notification-activity chartKey, hiddenSeries and accessible data/dataColumns; shared frame implementation not inspected.

components.name: Button / BUTTON_BASE / BUTTON_VARIANTS
components.contract: Native button, semantic variants, theme control/focus tokens, loading/disabled/aria-busy; anchor chrome reuses exported constants without changing navigation semantics.

components.name: SourceContent / useDataState
components.contract: loading/error/empty/retained/ready; fatal-only replacement and retained retry. Existing owner, no new state renderer needed.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: delay, children, className; reduced motion uses initial=false and zero safe delay; runtime motion unverified.

components.name: Domain evidence components
components.contract: InboxBody, InboxSummary, NotificationReportPanel, table/details/delivery, grouped row/row, filter bar and AlertDetailDrawer; retain rule-specific remediation, audit timeline and context navigation.

components.name: Other existing shared consumers
components.contract: GlassPanel, typography, Select, Checkbox, Modal, ConfirmDialog, BulkActionsToolbar, ListExportMenu, PullToRefresh, EntityPreviewDrawer, AI card, QueryError, EmptyState, StaleRefreshWarning and provenance. Mentioned as inspected consumer imports, not independently accepted implementations.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Details renderer is correctly reused by inline expansion and dialog; flat and grouped presentations are distinct workflows, not permission to delete either.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep shared domain details and delivery labels; consolidate only proven equivalent presentation helpers.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Archive navigation reconstructs button chrome even though BUTTON_BASE/BUTTON_VARIANTS already own it.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Compose existing exported button chrome onto native Link; preserve destination and localized label.

sourceStrategy: PageLayout full-width min-w-0; wrapping toolbar and grouped filters.
Flat table detects max-width 767px and keeps mobile notification header filters; mobileColumns=['title']; full details stay expandable.
Details grid becomes two columns at sm and three at lg; report breakdown grid two at sm and three at xl.
No duplicate date picker. Notifications intentionally disable header vehicle scope, so local vehicle filtering must survive.

issues.detail: Grouped row quick actions default to opacity-0 and become visible only on hover or focus-within. Touch discoverability is not explicitly supported by a mobile visibility branch; controls still occupy layout width.
issues.fix: Keep quick actions visible on touch/narrow layouts, with existing keyboard/context alternatives and no loss of metadata or actions.

sourcePositives: Localized action names, native buttons and links, aria-pressed view/severity toggles, grouped expansion controls/region IDs, shared dialogs and confirmation, list retry and bulk announcements, chart dataColumns and table details.
Root FadeIn uses the existing reduced-motion owner.

issues.detail: Archive Link uses min-h-9 (36px) and custom cyan focus styling instead of canonical focus tokens. No mobile 44px sizing branch or measured spacing exception is evidenced.
issues.fix: Reuse anchor button chrome and ensure mobile target/spacing acceptance without replacing Link with a mutation button.

issues.detail: Thread-member error has role=alert but no retry action; cached members also disappear on any query.error.
issues.fix: Adapt query to useDataState; retain rows on refresh failure and expose refetch through existing feedback/state controls.

states.summary: Initial skeleton via OperationalBrief; fatal QueryError with retry; resolved empty CTA; retained rows plus stale warning/provenance.
states.evidence: Flat/group source errors isolated; initial skeleton, distinct empty states and retry; count failure does not remove list; retained list and count warnings.
states.report: Historical trust adapter, initial loading, fatal retry, retained warning, persistent metrics/chart/five breakdown shells; unavailable is not measured zero.
states.detail: Alert summary remains when audit load fails; cached audit warning with retry; non-rule details in shared modal.

issues.detail: Vehicle and rule queries are destructured to data only and default to []. Initial, failed and successful-empty metadata become indistinguishable; rule/vehicle filters and joins have no independent trust/retry context.
issues.fix: Retain query objects and display nonfatal source notices/retry beside metadata-dependent controls while preserving IDs and successfully loaded notifications.

visualIssues.detail: Triggered and delivery series use fixed #22d3ee/#a78bfa fills rather than current chart palette preferences.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing palette owner; retain both series, identity, hiddenSeries behavior, axis/data-table/export support and explicit saved chart choices.

visualIssues.detail: Grouped row borders/hover/unread surfaces are fixed white alpha with fixed cyan unread accent; group expansion similarly uses cyan-200 at NotificationGroupRow:170. Root Link has white-alpha hover at InboxPage:59.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse surface/border/control/focus tokens and restrained semantic unread emphasis; preserve non-color read labels and theme settings.

visualIssues.detail: Details dt/dd and many table/group metadata spans hand-author text-xs/text-sm typography instead of current roles. Tokens for text colors are mostly already used.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing typography as overrides to retain dt/dd semantics, tabular timestamps and every metadata field; do not introduce a page font scale.

architectureIssues.detail: RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS includes /notifications/inbox but not mounted alias /notifications. Both render InboxPage with useRangeState; alias has no header-owned range control and does not receive the same header-owned default semantics.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should register the actual /notifications alias alongside /notifications/inbox, preserving all URL/preset/DST/timezone and local vehicle filtering behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: useGroupMembers merges all parent filters, including thread-list limit/offset. InboxBody:194 sets offset=(page-1)*pageSize. Expanded members on later thread pages inherit a thread-page offset, despite being a different result set; no independent member pagination is rendered.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must establish member pagination contract, separate thread offset from member offset and preserve complete filtered member reachability. Do not arbitrarily cap or fetch all without backend/scale evidence.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature component imports useToast from concrete feedback/Toast instead of existing feedback category barrel; InboxBody already uses the barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing feedback barrel without changing toast behavior or moving shared internals to their own barrel.

architectureIssues.detail: AI categorization receives vehicle/severity/rule IDs but no workspace from/to. Shared AI contract uses optional windowDays with default-seven-days intent; stream scopeKey omits workspace instants. A date change does not clear/cancel categories through the currently passed scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Expose truthful independent AI scope now; integration owner should verify backend bounds capability before extending existing typed AI request/scopeKey. Preserve propose-only review/apply and never invent support for arbitrary bounds.

priority.rationale: Small root already uses canonical layout and operational briefs. Most remaining modernization risks live in reused domain components or integration contracts, not a need to rebuild the page.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Workspace range route alias parity
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing getWorkspaceRouteScope(pathname).range: true for both assigned routes; vehicle:false remains intentional.
dependsOn: Existing saved rolling/custom date and timezone semantics
requiredSharedChanges.change: Add alias to existing owner; no new scope store or page picker.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Filtered thread-member pagination
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing useGroupMembers(groupKey, filters, {enabled}); separate thread-list limit/offset from member pagination, retain abort/query identity, retained data and explicit recovery.
requiredSharedChanges.change: Bounded integration fix to existing API owner; missing independent member pagination UI is a domain requirement, not grounds for a second list system.

requiredSharedChanges.name: AI inbox scope disclosure / capability verification
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing vehicleId/severities/ruleIds/windowDays/onApplyCategories; ready/streaming/paused-confirm/proposal states; preserve feature guard and cancel-on-scope-change. Exact instant bounds support is unknown.
requiredSharedChanges.change: Clarify independent request scope or extend existing owner only after backend capability proof; no new AI implementation.

competingImplementations.decision: Reuse useDataState/StaleRefreshWarning or SourceContent; do not create another error/loading/retention engine.
Reuse BUTTON_BASE/BUTTON_VARIANTS for Link; no new LinkButton wrapper is required by one consumer.
Keep both business views. Reuse details, delivery labels, filter controls and canonical table; do not treat distinct workflows as removable duplication.
Keep existing OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics and ChartContainer/DataTable; no competing KPI or chart library.

renderCounts.note: Root delegates sections; JSX branch occurrences are not mounted/runtime panel counts. No original-history comparison was run.

actions: Expand thread and mark group read
Chart legend visibility and existing frame capabilities
dataBehavior: Unfiltered active sample remains separate from filtered evidence and complete-period report.
Missing read_at is unread; unknown severity is attention, not silently recoded.
Preserve typed source counts, delivery/trigger distinction, uncorrelated delivery subtraction and fanout missing denominator.
Preserve all timestamps, errors, rule/vehicle/channel identity, raw exports and loaded/selected scope labels.
Preserve URL identity and existing query cancellation, cache, enablement and optimistic/broadcast behavior; mutation internals not fully inspected.
Retain nonfatal neighbors and cached data on background refresh failure.
No SI value, unit API or formatter migration was performed. Existing latency_ms notification metadata is retained verbatim; canonical backend unit contract was not verified and must not be guessed.
Preserve global mark-all scope and localStorage markOnOpen/markOnClick preferences; runtime audit would require fixtures because mounting can auto-mark real notifications.
Keep local vehicle filter because notifications intentionally hide the global vehicle picker; no duplicate date control.
Keep raw source/user text, localization, theme/chart preferences, mobile details and accessibility.
